text: The paper reports that even with a highly optimized prompt, zero-shot accuracy is often no better than random on the three benchmarks, while ICM matches golden supervision on TruthfulQA and GSM8K without any external labels. On Alpaca, ICM substantially outperforms training with preference labels annotated by real humans.
title: ICM matches golden supervision on TruthfulQA and GSM8K and beats human labels on Alpaca
